title: Deep NLP & Sequence-to-Sequence Models: Exploring Natural Language Processing

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome back to the course on deep natural language processing.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎回到深度自然語言處理課程。

cues.en: And today we're gonna talk about the types of natural language processing.
cues.zh: 今天談自然語言處理的類型。

cues.en: So we've got two Venn diagrams here, or we've got a Venn diagram with two circles in it.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩張文氏圖，或者說，一張包含兩個圓的文氏圖。

cues.en: And we are going to look at the different areas of natural language processing
cues.zh: 要看看自然語言處理的不同領域，

cues.en: that are going to come up in this course.
cues.zh: 也就是本課會介紹的。

cues.en: So, on the left, we've got natural language processing overall, and this refers to the whole circle on the left.
cues.zh: 左邊是整體自然語言處理，代表整個左側圓。

cues.en: So the reason why we've colored in just this green part is because that's the non-overlapping part.
cues.zh: 只把綠色這區塗色，是因為它沒有重疊。

cues.en: So we know that anything in here is just natural language processing with disregard to this second circle.
cues.zh: 所以這裡都是單純的 NLP，先不考慮第二個圓。

cues.en: But natural language processing is indeed everything that is in this first circle.
cues.zh: 但自然語言處理確實包含第一個圓的所有東西。

cues.en: Then, we've got on the right, deep learning.
cues.zh: 右邊是深度學習。

cues.en: So these are all algorithms that have something to do with neural networks, deep learning, basically anything that's called the deep learning algorithm falls in here.
cues.zh: 所有與神經網路、深度學習有關的演算法，基本上叫深度學習的，都在這裡。

cues.en: They don't have to be natural language processing.
cues.zh: 不一定是自然語言處理。

cues.en: They can be classification.
cues.zh: 可能分類。

cues.en: They can be anything.
cues.zh: 也可能任何事情。

cues.en: So they can be, that's deep learning over here.
cues.zh: 這就是深度學習。

cues.en: And natural language processing is any algorithm, any model that has something to do with processing of natural language into machine terms.
cues.zh: 自然語言處理則是任何把自然語言處理成機器能理解形式的演算法或模型。

cues.en: And then finally in the overlap, we have deep NLP.
cues.zh: 最後，重疊處是深度 NLP。

cues.en: So these are models which have to do with natural language processing, but also which are deep learning models, which are neural network models.
cues.zh: 這些模型與 NLP 有關，同時也是深度學習、神經網路模型。

cues.en: And yeah, so that's the part that we're going to be aiming for.
cues.zh: 這是我們想達到的部分。

cues.en: But it's also very good to have a visibility of all three, because in this course, we will be talking about some models that fall just in here.
cues.zh: 但認識三區都很好，因為本課會先談只落在這裡的模型，

cues.en: And then we'll be talking about models here, and it'll be good to compare and see how the world has changed over time, and why these models are often better than these models.
cues.zh: 再談這裡的；可以比較隨時間如何變化，為什麼這些通常比那些更好。

cues.en: And the other thing to note here is that the size of these diagrams is not reflective of the importance or the volumes of these different fields.
cues.zh: 另外注意，圖的大小不反映各領域的重要性或規模。

cues.en: So I just set circles of the same size, simply because we want a visual representation of the overlap, and that these fields exist, but don't take the size into account.
cues.zh: 只是用同樣大小的圓，呈現重疊和領域存在，不要考慮尺寸。

cues.en: It's not to scale at all.
cues.zh: 完全沒有按比例。

cues.en: And finally, there is another part, another part of this Venn diagram, which is very important to us.
cues.zh: 最後，文氏圖還有另一個對我們非常重要的部分。

cues.en: And it is this part over here, a sub-section of a deep NLP called sequence-to-sequence.
cues.zh: 這裡，深度 NLP 子領域，叫序列到序列。

cues.en: So sequence-to-sequence models are the most cutting edge, the most powerful models that exist right now for national language processing.
cues.zh: 序列到序列模型，是錄製當時 NLP 最前沿、最強大的模型。

cues.en: And that's what we are going to be looking at.
cues.zh: 這是要探索的。

cues.en: So as you'll see throughout this course, we will make our way through the natural language processing side of things into deep NLP, and then we will go into sequence-to-sequence.
cues.zh: 本課會從自然語言處理，一路進入深度 NLP，再進序列到序列。

cues.en: It'll be a fun and exciting journey.
cues.zh: 會是有趣、精彩的旅程。

cues.en: And the other thing that I wanted to mention is you will also notice that throughout this course, even though it's focused on chat bots, we won't be talking about just chat bots.
cues.zh: 還想提到，雖然本課著重聊天機器人，但不會只談聊天機器人。

cues.en: We will be looking at different examples of how these models from here and from here and from here can be applied to different things.
cues.zh: 會看這些區域的模型，如何應用於不同事情。

cues.en: Because the applications are huge.
cues.zh: 因為應用非常廣。

cues.en: We can apply them in a natural neural machine translation.
cues.zh: 可以用於神經機器翻譯。

cues.en: We can apply them in image captioning.
cues.zh: 也能圖片描述。

cues.en: We can apply them in speech recognition, questions and answers, text memorization, lots and lots of models.
cues.zh: 還有語音辨識、問答、文字記憶，很多模型。

cues.en: So we will be looking at different ones, and they will be of different types.
cues.zh: 會看不同模型、不同類型。

cues.en: So this map will come in handy as we go through the course, and it will be popping up here and there.
cues.zh: 所以這張地圖在課程中很有用，會不時出現。

cues.en: So I think it was very important for us to set the foundation right so that now we're ready to proceed.
cues.zh: 建立正確基礎非常重要，現在準備繼續了。

cues.en: And I can't wait to see you on the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂再見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy deep and natural language processing.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受深度自然語言處理的樂趣。
